title: Need help with picking a shader for the water
author: RUSuper
selftext:
Really torn between 2 shaders here for water. So which one do you think looks better and more fitting for the game

*Processing img 96yq3l3ufjqh1...*

*Processing img 10nww62zfjqh1...*

I feel like water 1 is "calm" while default "calm" state for water 2 is... not as calm. For some reason I like water 2 more, but looking at the sea today while passing by (as I live close to the sea) really made me think how Water 1 is just... more like a real sea.

Wanted to put a poll, but either I'm too dumb for that or there is no option for it.
